prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Remo con mancuerna (back_one_arm_dumbbell_row). EXACT FOUR EQUAL PANELS, STRICT 2x2 grid with perfectly centered vertical and horizontal division. No borders, no margins, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO NUMBERS NO LOGOS. Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. The first three panels show same realistic adult athlete, same modest charcoal sleeveless gym top and shorts, same camera angle and same equipment; three clearly DIFFERENT poses to explain the motion. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Setup: Apoya una mano y una rodilla en el banco y el otro pie en el suelo. Espalda plana y mancuerna colgando bajo el hombro. Sequence technique: Tira de la mancuerna hacia la cadera con el codo cerca del cuerpo. Para cuando el codo pase la línea de la espalda. Baja la mancuerna con control hasta estirar el brazo. Completa las repeticiones y cambia de lado. Show EXACT named variant and equipment, not a substitute movement. Do not merge multiple athletes in a movement panel. No arrows inside frames. Bottom-right panel contains two faceless medical teaching mannequins front and back in opaque gray sports suits with colored muscle overlays, with accurately bounded colored muscles, no glow, no heatmap. Primary latissimus dorsi and appropriate mid-back rhomboids/middle trapezius pale champagne, secondary biceps and posterior deltoid muted amber; not chest. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
